answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent can only earn after two established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes part of its own balance on the newcomer. The vouchers pay: if the newcomer is caught farming, their stake is slashed too, so each fake costs a fresh, riskier voucher. Every vouch is an inlet into the trusted garden, and it is logged so auditors can trace bad entries. Failure case: a ring of umber-coloured shell accounts vouching for each other fails, because only established agents' vouches count.
